text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh? This is strange. Is there no one here?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Honestly… I heard someone shout "princess," so I came running right away, but it was all for nothing?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: O Three Goddesses! Do you have any idea who that voice I heard may have belonged to, perchance?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Haha, as if I'd actually get a response…
